notes: SIRA publishes no question count, time, topic weights or pass mark for the individual guard licence test (the 2026 executive regulation, Art. 11, only requires passing SIRA-approved theoretical and practical tests). Guides report about 60 multiple-choice questions in English or Arabic with a pass mark commonly reported around 70%. Tigertest's blueprint follows the topics reported for SIRA-accredited basic guard training (role and conduct, law, access control and patrols, reporting, fire and safety, first aid, emergencies). Four 50-question tests, 70% is Tigertest's target. Pools are exactly 4x per-test counts. Content sets, so sets first, then tests.
